name: antevo-guard
description: Check a company before you pay it — the company register, VAT validation, its LEI, and the website and email domain an invoice came from, each finding with its source and date. With an Antevo sign-in, keep a payee book that is re-read for changes, check an invoice or a change-of-bank-details letter, and watch for lookalikes of your own company name. It never takes a bank account number and never says whether to pay.
